snippet.title: Chronoscript: The Endless End - "Age of Discovery" Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming in 2026 
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4018380/Chronoscript_The_Endless_End/?utm_source=shueishagames&utm_campaign=&utm_medium=youtube


“A thousand years of words… waiting for your final mark.

“Chronoscript: The Endless End” is an exploration-based action-adventure game where you, an editor trapped within a manuscript, must unravel a thousand-year story that writes itself beyond its end—across 2D pages and a 3D manor.

The interior of the writer's mansion resembles a private museum, adorned with rooms themed around various "eras" of world history. In this world-premiere trailer, you can witness the "Age of Discovery" stage - a symbol of discovery and pioneering - and the fierce battles against the enemies lurking within.

▶︎ Follow us for the latest updates:
